Andy Burnham to become UK PM, drops digital ID plan

Andy Burnham is set to become the United Kingdom's next Prime Minister on Monday, succeeding Keir Starmer. Upon taking office, Burnham plans to scrap the digital ID scheme initiated by Starmer, reallocating resources to address the cost of living crisis. His transition to leadership is being closely watched for its potential impact on domestic policy and international relations.
